positions.title: SEM Engineer | Business Intelligence
positions.description:
• Used a combination of Perl and MySQL to automate the  implementation and optimization of PPC campaigns for a large, enterprise level Google Adwords account.

• Built an application that takes large sets of proposed keywords for SEM accounts and generates bids for those keywords. The application analyzes historic bidding trends and the patterns of user search terms for semantic relationships with the proposed new keywords in order to create appropriate bids.

• Participated in code reviews with other developers and data engineers to help maintain a culture of releasing production code that is robust, extensible, and well organized.

• Lead the design and implementation of SEM projects that interfaced with multiple departments across the company including our content and product management teams.

• Promoted from Customer Service Representative

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted professors during science workshops and outreach programs for Chicago Public School students covering topics such as the science of acoustics, electronics, biology, and solar energy.

Ran an eight-week workshop on the science of sound with high school students as well as hands-on instruction for scriptwriting, stop-and-go animation, and audio/video editing.

Gave lectures on budgeting, professionalism, and college survival skills.

projects.title: RouteTracker API
projects.description:
Route Tracker API is one of my many software development side projects. I am currently the sole developer and am in charge of the entire SDLC. I am responsible for bootstrapping the cloud server, managing the git repository, coding, and designing the unit and functional tests.

Overview:
The RouteTracker API's purpose is to encapsulate calls to the Chicago Transit Authority's bus and train APIs. It creates objects that are more easily consumable for a mobile app. Additionally, it helps cache results to minimize exhausting the limit of calls per day set by the CTA for a given API key. The deployable format is an uber/fat jar with an embedded Tomcat HTTP server. RouteTracker API will support an Android application that I am developing in parallel. Every so often, I re-write the backend in a different language, e.g Kotlin, Node, Haskell and add new elements e.g  container orchestration with kubernetes or messaging with Apache Kafka as a way to explore a given technology stack.

Technologies Used:
Spring Framework with Spring Boot and Maven
CTA Bus Tracker/Train Tracker(Beta) API
Digital Ocean [Ubuntu 16.04] Cloud Server (for deployment)
JUnit
CircleCI
Jackson
Eclipse
Git - https://github.com/smithlamar/route_tracker_api
